summary: A host that keeps no history announces no recent, and the panel offers neither the block nor its two intents.

then.note: reason is capability-not-provided. No recent block, no crosses, no «Clear»: the empty field then shows the popular queries, the commands, or the start prompt. The panel never falls back to browser storage of its own -- that was the sf-admin-menu defect simai.composite-component 1.0.3 instance-isolation was written for.
